title: Martin,
html_source: Is this a Joycean slip-up? Power has asked Cunningham to tell Dedalus about the previous night’s singing. So why does Martin Cunningham address his comment to “Martin”. I would infer that Cunningham should be addressing “Simon”. Or am I missing something?

anchor.prefix:
said eagerly. Wait till1961#90 you hear him, Simon, on Ben Dollard's singing of The Croppy Boy. 

 — Immense, Martin Cunningham said pompously. His singing of that simple ballad,
anchor.suffix:
is the most trenchant rendering I ever heard in the whole course of my experience.
